abstract: Architecture, design, and implementation patterns for purposeinplay Go services. Based on DDD, CQRS, and Clean Architecture principles from Three Dots Labs, extended with org-specific conventions: go-commons/errors, *T pointers for nullables, oapi-codegen OpenAPI-first workflow, GORM adapters, caarlos0/env config, graceful shutdown, and precision-safe monetary amounts (NUMERIC(38,18) + shopspring/decimal end-to-end). Contains 12 rules across three groups: core architecture (5 rules), purposeinplay implementation (4 rules), domain conventions (1 rule), plus security and testing.
